bioconda.name: branchmanager
bioconda.summary: Microbial isolate tracking, marker-gene QC, and WGS prioritisation
bioconda.description: BranchManager is a decision-support toolkit for microbial isolate collections. It validates partner submissions, processes Sanger AB1 chromatograms, assembles marker-gene sequences, compares taxonomy against reference databases, measures novelty relative to cultured and sequence-reference baselines, and helps prioritise isolates for whole-genome sequencing. Reference databases and  biological baselines are supplied and maintained separately by the user.
